script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

JOHN (40s, a successful but tired businessman) enters the room, dropping his keys on the table. He looks at a family photo on the mantelpiece. His wife, LUCY (30s), and their two children, MARK (12) and EMMA (10), smile back at him.

JOHN
(to himself)
I need to be more present.

Suddenly, his phone rings. He checks the caller ID and hesitates. It's his boss. He answers the call.

JOHN
(into phone)
Yes, sir? I'll be there as soon as I can.

INT. JOHN'S OFFICE - DAY

John sits at his desk, staring at a stack of papers. His phone rings again. It's Lucy.

LUCY (V.O.)
John, Mark and Emma are waiting for you at the park. They want to show you something.

John sighs, frustrated, but then grins.

JOHN
I'll be there soon. Love you all.

EXT. LOCAL PARK - DAY

John enters the park, where he finds Mark and Emma playing with a kite. They run up to him, excitedly.

MARK
Daddy, look! We made it fly!

John bends down and helps them reel in the kite.

EMMA
Daddy, can we have an ice cream after?

JOHN
Of course, sweetie.

INT. ICE CREAM PARLOR - DAY

The family sits at a table, enjoying their ice creams.

LUCY
John, you've been working so much lately. You deserve a break.

JOHN
I know, Lucy. I just need to catch up on some projects.

MARK
But we miss you, Daddy.

EMMA
And you're always so tired when you come home.

John looks at his children, feeling guilty.

JOHN
You're right. I need to find a better balance.

INT. JOHN'S HOME OFFICE - NIGHT

John sits at his computer, typing out an email.

Subject: Resignation

Dear [BOSS],

It is with a heavy heart that I must resign from my position as Senior Marketing Manager, effective two weeks from today. I have come to realize that my work is not the only thing that matters in my life. I want to be present for my family, to support them and enjoy their company. I believe this decision will ultimately be beneficial for both me and the company.

Sincerely,
John

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

John enters the living room, where Lucy and the children are waiting for him. They all look up at him, curious.

JOHN
I've decided to resign from my job.

LUCY
(surprised)
Really? Why?

JOHN
Because I want to be here for you and the kids. I don't want to miss out on any more of your lives.

MARK
Wow, that's awesome, Dad!

EMMA
Yes, you'll be the best stay-at-home dad ever!

The family shares a heartfelt moment, grateful for the second chance at a more balanced life.

FADE OUT.
